interpretations: For each rating, average the films’ replacement costs and their individual daily rental prices (`rental_rate / rental_duration`). Compute the unweighted mean of the five rating-level daily prices, retain ratings above that mean, and return one unrounded row containing the unweighted mean of their average replacement costs, the unweighted mean of their daily prices, and the mean difference between their daily prices and the five-rating mean.
queries:
WITH rating_averages AS (
  SELECT
    rating,
    AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost,
    AVG(rental_rate * 1.0 / rental_duration) AS avg_daily_price
  FROM film
  GROUP BY rating
),
five_rating_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_daily_price) AS mean_daily_price
  FROM rating_averages
)
SELECT
  AVG(r.avg_replacement_cost) AS mean_replacement_cost,
  AVG(r.avg_daily_price) AS mean_daily_price,
  AVG(r.avg_daily_price - m.mean_daily_price) AS mean_difference
FROM rating_averages AS r
CROSS JOIN five_rating_mean AS m
WHERE r.avg_daily_price > m.mean_daily_price
